passA.by: Claude (AI agent), build session: transcription agent A

passB.method: Independent transcription from page renders only (Poppler pdftoppm, 300 to 400 dpi, enlarged crops for small print). The agent had no access to the text layer, to pass A, or to the source survey; its tool log was checked for this

tables.notes: Columns equation, factor, and term were prefilled. The build engineer prefilled the header row and the row-key cells listed here from a one-pass survey of the source; both passes checked those cells against the page and neither changed them. "sign" is the sign printed before the term inside its bracket; "value" is the unsigned printed number (the divisor for a term written as X/c). The text layer of this paper turns decimal points into colons and drops minus signs, so pass A read every equation from the render. By the transcription rules, every minus sign in a number or equation is written as U+2212 (−), whatever glyph the source uses (the LiFFT DOCX uses a hyphen-minus, and some DUET sentences use an en dash); labels keep their printed en dashes.
